title: CheckVerdict
description: Owner accept/reject of a shared check. Weights the rule. No owner name, page id, or protocol text.

verdict.description: accept increases the rule's weight; reject decreases it.

lab_novelty.description: new = this lab has not previously verdicted this check. Headline metric uses new-lab accepts.

weight_delta.description: Optional explicit delta; default +1 for accept, -1 for reject.
